ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Weeping Stones — Stocked Pool
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
STOCKED_POOL_BUILD_1 (owner typed 2026-09-24, on `WEEPING_STONES_FISH_HUSBANDRY_1`: "love it. Moisture farmers specializing in fish. Ripe possibilities for rimcuisine stuff too. Make the fish nasty and way too active. And some shouldn't be fish but alien beasts you really wonder if we should be eating.")
This mod is the Weeping Stones' STOCKED line, in the RM_ (RimMandrake) tier: franchise-free, invented names only (Q11a), rich enough to stand alone with no Star Wars dependency. It is distinct from the WILD catch (the ruled gentle six wild fish, unchanged) — nastiness is what domestication and crowding do; the pen makes the monster, never the shore.
The bestiary: `RM_Murrin` (the gentle baseline), four "nasty and way too active" fish (`RM_Skarrin` the ring-breaker jumper, `RM_Karrek` the swarm-flenser, `RM_Vizhik` the traveling pot-eel, `RM_Vhorrin` the mismanagement state made flesh), and three catches that are not fish at all (`RM_Loomu` the caller, `RM_Huldu` the warm one, `RM_Ivvol` the tally) — the best eating in the biome, and nobody eats them comfortably.
Cuisine hooks: six recipes/ingredients including a real doubt-meat mood economy — per-beast "Ate X" thoughts (loomu/huldu/ivvol), graded by callousness/psychopathy, diluted in mixed meals, undiluted in the named roast.
**Build state (2026-09-24, wave 1):** the bestiary (pawn race + PawnKindDef pairs) and the cuisine layer (meat items, recipes, doubt-meat ThoughtDefs) ship this wave. The husbandry LOOP — pen zone designator, per-pool-body `RM_MapComponent_PoolStock` bookkeeping (stealing `RM_LiquidBody`'s region logic), ring-density READ overlay art, handler-injury toil failures, vizhik escape events, and the vhorrin cull set-piece — is the honest hard part and ships in a following wave. None of these species are wired into the live `RUT_WeepingStones` BiomeDef's `wildAnimals`/`fishTypes` yet: that wiring waits on `WEEPINGSTONES_RM_MOD_BUILD_1` landing the `RM_WeepingStones` BiomeDef this mod's content is meant to populate. Until both land, this mod ships inert defs with no spawn path — degrades clean, breaks nothing.
**Mod Settings** (MOD_OPTIONS_RETROFIT_1 doctrine): a master "Stocked pools enabled" toggle, off by default until the husbandry loop ships, so enabling this mod today changes nothing about a running game. When the loop lands the toggle gates the whole mechanism; wild fishing (the ruled gentle six) is never touched by it.
